Overview

Larnaca is a city in Larnaca District with a population of 84,000. Cyprus’ third-largest city and a major port, known for its palm-tree seafront promenade, the Church of Saint Lazarus, and the Larnaca Salt Lake. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
